test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for the blank in the sentence below.

Despite knowing the importance of the assignment, Rahul kept delaying it until the last minute - a clear case of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. procrastination .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence highlights Rahul’s tendency to delay or postpone tasks despite their importance.
 
• The word that fits best in this context is **"procrastination"**, which means the action of delaying or postponing something.
 
• Other options like **exaggeration, temptation, or negotiation** do not align with the context of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *Despite knowing the importance of the assignment, Rahul kept delaying it until the last minute - a clear case of **procrastination**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Procrastination:** Refers to the act of delaying or postponing tasks, often unnecessarily.
 
• **Exaggeration:** Means overstating or making something appear larger or more significant than it actually is.
 
• **Temptation:** Refers to the desire to do something, especially something wrong or unwise.
 
• **Negotiation:** Involves discussions aimed at reaching an agreement.
